description: This file contains unit tests for the Sanitizer utility class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing SVG sanitization to prevent cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerabilities.

classes.name: SanitizerTest
classes.description: A unit test class for the Sanitizer utility, verifying SVG sanitization functionalities to mitigate XSS risks.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creating instances of Sanitizer and DOMDocument.

methods.name: testSanitizeSVGWithScriptTag
methods.description: Verifies that SVG containing a <script> tag is sanitized by removing the script element.

methods.name: testSanitizeSVGWithOnClick
methods.description: Checks that SVG with an onclick attribute has the attribute removed after sanitization.

methods.name: testSanitizeSVGWithAnimate
methods.description: Ensures that SVG with an <animate> element with malicious onbegin attribute is sanitized by removing the element.

methods.name: testSanitizeSVGWithRegularSVG
methods.description: Confirms that a well-formed SVG remains unchanged after sanitization.

methods.name: testSanitizeSVGWithBadlyFormattedSVG
methods.description: Tests that badly formatted SVG throws a SanitizerException indicating improper formatting.
